subject: Cutover readiness: API keys, org seed, IP allowlist & VPC peering – close plan
messages:
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ishaan Rao <ishaan@aurishealth.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@aurishealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 18:34:00 +0000
Subject: Cutover readiness: API keys, org seed, IP allowlist & VPC peering – close plan

Hi Ishaan / Sarah —

Thanks again for the productive walkthrough yesterday. Per our MAP milestone, we want to lock the technical close plan so your engineering team can hit the scheduled POC cutover window the week of Nov 8. This note summarizes the final checklist and owners so everyone has a single source of truth. I attached a one‑page MAP and the VPC diagram for reference.

Quick TL;DR (asks for this week):
- Auris: confirm the CIDR ranges for the VPC peering and add Redwood control-plane IPs to your allowlist (see vpc-peering-diagram.png).
- Auris: create an ‘auris-prod-eval’ org seed in your tenant and share the primary org_id.
- Redwood: we’ll provision ephemeral API keys scoped to the eval org (rotation 7 days). We’ll send the key delivery steps and a short audit record.
- Both: sign off on the security checklist in the attached Redwood_MAP_AurisHealth_v2.pdf by EOD Friday so procurement can finalize the trial agreement.

Notes on ownership:
- VPC peering / network: Jordan Blake (cc’d) 
- Org + API key provisioning: Lauren Bishop (cc’d) + me for coordination
- Security questionnaire & audit artifacts: I will drop the SOC2 extract into the shared Drive after sign off

Attachments included: Redwood_MAP_AurisHealth_v2.pdf (MAP, milestones & signoffs), vpc-peering-diagram.png, apikey-provisioning-steps.txt

Proposed short cadence: we’ll have 30m check-in on Thursday to confirm CIDRs and key handoff (Jordan + Auris network lead). If anything blocks earlier, ping me directly.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwoodinference.com

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference runtime
From: Ishaan Rao <ishaan@aurishealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@aurishealth.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cutover readiness: API keys, org seed, IP allowlist & VPC peering – close plan

Rishi —

Thanks for the clear rundown. Quick answers from our side: 
- CIDR: we plan to use 10.40.0.0/16 for the test VPC; we can carve a /24 for peering if that’s required.
- Org seed: Sarah will create the eval org today and share the org_id.
- Security: procurement needs the MAP doc for legal; we’ll aim to return signed by Friday but may need a short clarifying call on two clauses (data residency / log retention).

Two clarifying Qs: 
1) For API keys — are you delivering keys via DocuSign or direct SFTP? We prefer not to receive keys in clear email.
2) Peering: do you require a dedicated BGP session or will a static route + peering suffice for the evaluation?

I’ll be available for the Thursday 30m; Jordan — can you confirm you have bandwidth for that slot?

Thanks,
Ishaan
Head of Platform Integrations | AurisHealth
ishaan@aurishealth.com
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ishaan Rao <ishaan@aurishealth.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@aurishealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 14:41:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Cutover readiness: API keys, org seed, IP allowlist & VPC peering – close plan

Ishaan — thanks, that CIDR works. Quick responses inline below and next steps: 

> 1) For API keys — are you delivering keys via DocuSign or direct SFTP? We prefer not to receive keys in clear email.

We will NOT send keys over email. Our standard is to deliver ephemeral keys via the customer portal and register an audit event in the MAP doc. For customers that need programmatic delivery, we can push to a short‑lived S3 presigned URL with HMAC verification. I’ll send the provisioning steps to the shared Drive and flag the audit record. (Attachment: apikey-provisioning-steps.txt)

> 2) Peering: do you require a dedicated BGP session or will a static route + peering suffice for the evaluation?

For POC we typically do static route peering (simpler), unless you want to validate resilience with BGP. Jordan — if we go static for this eval, can you confirm the peer IPs and the expected advertised routes?

Next steps / dates: 
- Wed 21 Oct: Sarah sends org_id 
- Thu 22 Oct 15:00 ET: 30m network + key delivery check-in (Jordan + Auris network lead) — I’ll send a calendar invite after you confirm
- Fri 23 Oct EOD: MAP signature (legal/procurement) to unblock procurement & trial agreement

Ishaan — will you confirm the preferred key delivery (portal vs presigned URL) and confirm Jordan’s bandwidth?

Best,
Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

--
Attachment referenced: apikey-provisioning-steps.txt
From: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 14:06:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Cutover readiness: API keys, org seed, IP allowlist & VPC peering – close plan

Looping back after prepping the provisioning doc: 
- I reviewed the apikey-provisioning-steps.txt (draft) and added a short checklist for your security team to validate key scopes. I uploaded the updated file to the Drive link Rishi included and set comments where we’ll require Auris sign-off.
- Jordan: I’ve added the static-peer IPs we typically advertise for POC to the vpc-peering-diagram.png layer and marked expected routes. If you need alternative ranges (Ishaan’s team proposed a /24), we can adjust.
- I’ll be on the Thu 22 Oct 15:00 ET check-in and will bring a short runbook for the key rotation and audit event creation.

If procurement hits a hold for residency text, flag legal early — we can propose a short addendum that meets evaluation needs without altering primary terms.

Thanks — we’re on track to close the MAP this week.

Lauren Bishop
Platform Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwoodinference.com
